title: AgroIoT - Estado de la planta (estadísticas)
description: Estadísticas del estado de la planta calculadas sobre el DWH (lecturas limpias por el ETL).

list.name: planta
list.label: Planta
list.query: SELECT DISTINCT entity_id FROM lectura_limpia ORDER BY 1

target.rawSql: SELECT ts AS time, tipo AS title, mensaje AS text, severidad AS tags FROM alerta WHERE entity_id = '$planta' AND $__timeFilter(ts)

panels.title: Índice de salud
panels.description: 0-100, mismo cálculo que el panel web (umbrales.js). Última lectura.

targets.rawSql:
SELECT GREATEST(0, LEAST(100, 100
  - CASE WHEN temperature IS NULL THEN 8 ELSE
      (CASE WHEN temperature < 15 OR temperature > 30 THEN 15 ELSE 0 END)
    + (CASE WHEN temperature < 10 OR temperature > 35 THEN 20 ELSE 0 END) END
  - CASE WHEN humidity IS NULL THEN 5 WHEN humidity < 30 OR humidity > 90 THEN 10 ELSE 0 END
  - CASE WHEN luminosity IS NULL THEN 5 WHEN luminosity < 1000 THEN 15 ELSE 0 END
  - CASE WHEN soil_moisture IS NULL THEN 10
         WHEN soil_moisture < 40 THEN LEAST(45, (40 - soil_moisture) * 1.5)
         WHEN soil_moisture > 85 THEN 15 ELSE 0 END)) AS salud FROM lectura_limpia WHERE entity_id = '$planta' ORDER BY ts DESC LIMIT 1

panels.title: Temperatura actual
panels.description: Óptimo 10-35, ideal 15-30. Verde = ideal, naranja = aceptable, rojo = fuera de rango.

targets.rawSql: SELECT temperature FROM lectura_limpia WHERE entity_id = '$planta' AND temperature IS NOT NULL ORDER BY ts DESC LIMIT 1

panels.title: Humedad del aire actual
panels.description: Óptimo 30-90, ideal 40-80. Verde = ideal, naranja = aceptable, rojo = fuera de rango.

targets.rawSql: SELECT humidity FROM lectura_limpia WHERE entity_id = '$planta' AND humidity IS NOT NULL ORDER BY ts DESC LIMIT 1

panels.title: Luminosidad actual
panels.description: Óptimo 1000-80000, ideal 5000-60000. Verde = ideal, naranja = aceptable, rojo = fuera de rango.

targets.rawSql: SELECT luminosity FROM lectura_limpia WHERE entity_id = '$planta' AND luminosity IS NOT NULL ORDER BY ts DESC LIMIT 1

panels.title: Humedad del suelo actual
panels.description: Óptimo 20-80, ideal 40-70. Verde = ideal, naranja = aceptable, rojo = fuera de rango.

targets.rawSql: SELECT soil_moisture FROM lectura_limpia WHERE entity_id = '$planta' AND soil_moisture IS NOT NULL ORDER BY ts DESC LIMIT 1

panels.title: Salud promedio del periodo
panels.description: Promedio del índice de salud en el rango de tiempo elegido.

targets.rawSql:
SELECT avg(GREATEST(0, LEAST(100, 100
  - CASE WHEN temperature IS NULL THEN 8 ELSE
      (CASE WHEN temperature < 15 OR temperature > 30 THEN 15 ELSE 0 END)
    + (CASE WHEN temperature < 10 OR temperature > 35 THEN 20 ELSE 0 END) END
  - CASE WHEN humidity IS NULL THEN 5 WHEN humidity < 30 OR humidity > 90 THEN 10 ELSE 0 END
  - CASE WHEN luminosity IS NULL THEN 5 WHEN luminosity < 1000 THEN 15 ELSE 0 END
  - CASE WHEN soil_moisture IS NULL THEN 10
         WHEN soil_moisture < 40 THEN LEAST(45, (40 - soil_moisture) * 1.5)
         WHEN soil_moisture > 85 THEN 15 ELSE 0 END))) AS salud FROM lectura_limpia WHERE entity_id = '$planta' AND $__timeFilter(ts)
SELECT count(*) AS lecturas FROM lectura_limpia WHERE entity_id = '$planta' AND $__timeFilter(ts)
SELECT count(*) AS alertas FROM alerta WHERE entity_id = '$planta' AND $__timeFilter(ts)

panels.title: Última lectura hace
panels.description: Si pasa de 5 min la placa dejó de enviar.

targets.rawSql: SELECT EXTRACT(EPOCH FROM now() - max(ts)) AS segundos FROM lectura_limpia WHERE entity_id = '$planta'

panels.title: Salud de la planta en el tiempo

targets.rawSql:
SELECT $__timeGroupAlias(ts, $__interval), avg(GREATEST(0, LEAST(100, 100
  - CASE WHEN temperature IS NULL THEN 8 ELSE
      (CASE WHEN temperature < 15 OR temperature > 30 THEN 15 ELSE 0 END)
    + (CASE WHEN temperature < 10 OR temperature > 35 THEN 20 ELSE 0 END) END
  - CASE WHEN humidity IS NULL THEN 5 WHEN humidity < 30 OR humidity > 90 THEN 10 ELSE 0 END
  - CASE WHEN luminosity IS NULL THEN 5 WHEN luminosity < 1000 THEN 15 ELSE 0 END
  - CASE WHEN soil_moisture IS NULL THEN 10
         WHEN soil_moisture < 40 THEN LEAST(45, (40 - soil_moisture) * 1.5)
         WHEN soil_moisture > 85 THEN 15 ELSE 0 END))) AS salud FROM lectura_limpia WHERE entity_id = '$planta' AND $__timeFilter(ts) GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 1

panels.title: Resumen estadístico por variable
panels.description: Calculado sobre las lecturas limpias del DWH (los valores descartados por el ETL no cuentan).

targets.rawSql:
SELECT 'Temperatura' AS "Variable", '°C' AS "Unidad", count(temperature) AS "N válidas", round(avg(temperature)::numeric, 2) AS "Media", round(min(temperature)::numeric, 2) AS "Mínimo", round(max(temperature)::numeric, 2) AS "Máximo", round(stddev_samp(temperature)::numeric, 2) AS "Desv. estándar", round((percentile_cont(0.5) WITHIN GROUP (ORDER BY temperature))::numeric, 2) AS "Mediana", round((percentile_cont(0.05) WITHIN GROUP (ORDER BY temperature))::numeric, 2) AS "P5", round((percentile_cont(0.95) WITHIN GROUP (ORDER BY temperature))::numeric, 2) AS "P95", round((100.0 * count(*) FILTER (WHERE temperature BETWEEN 10 AND 35) / NULLIF(count(temperature), 0))::numeric, 1) AS "% en óptimo" FROM lectura_limpia WHERE entity_id = '$planta' AND $__timeFilter(ts)
UNION ALL
SELECT 'Humedad del aire' AS "Variable", '%' AS "Unidad", count(humidity) AS "N válidas", round(avg(humidity)::numeric, 2) AS "Media", round(min(humidity)::numeric, 2) AS "Mínimo", round(max(humidity)::numeric, 2) AS "Máximo", round(stddev_samp(humidity)::numeric, 2) AS "Desv. estándar", round((percentile_cont(0.5) WITHIN GROUP (ORDER BY humidity))::numeric, 2) AS "Mediana", round((percentile_cont(0.05) WITHIN GROUP (ORDER BY humidity))::numeric, 2) AS "P5", round((percentile_cont(0.95) WITHIN GROUP (ORDER BY humidity))::numeric, 2) AS "P95", round((100.0 * count(*) FILTER (WHERE humidity BETWEEN 30 AND 90) / NULLIF(count(humidity), 0))::numeric, 1) AS "% en óptimo" FROM lectura_limpia WHERE entity_id = '$planta' AND $__timeFilter(ts)
UNION ALL
SELECT 'Luminosidad' AS "Variable", 'lx' AS "Unidad", count(luminosity) AS "N válidas", round(avg(luminosity)::numeric, 2) AS "Media", round(min(luminosity)::numeric, 2) AS "Mínimo", round(max(luminosity)::numeric, 2) AS "Máximo", round(stddev_samp(luminosity)::numeric, 2) AS "Desv. estándar", round((percentile_cont(0.5) WITHIN GROUP (ORDER BY luminosity))::numeric, 2) AS "Mediana", round((percentile_cont(0.05) WITHIN GROUP (ORDER BY luminosity))::numeric, 2) AS "P5", round((percentile_cont(0.95) WITHIN GROUP (ORDER BY luminosity))::numeric, 2) AS "P95", round((100.0 * count(*) FILTER (WHERE luminosity BETWEEN 1000 AND 80000) / NULLIF(count(luminosity), 0))::numeric, 1) AS "% en óptimo" FROM lectura_limpia WHERE entity_id = '$planta' AND $__timeFilter(ts)
UNION ALL
SELECT 'Humedad del suelo' AS "Variable", '%' AS "Unidad", count(soil_moisture) AS "N válidas", round(avg(soil_moisture)::numeric, 2) AS "Media", round(min(soil_moisture)::numeric, 2) AS "Mínimo", round(max(soil_moisture)::numeric, 2) AS "Máximo", round(stddev_samp(soil_moisture)::numeric, 2) AS "Desv. estándar", round((percentile_cont(0.5) WITHIN GROUP (ORDER BY soil_moisture))::numeric, 2) AS "Mediana", round((percentile_cont(0.05) WITHIN GROUP (ORDER BY soil_moisture))::numeric, 2) AS "P5", round((percentile_cont(0.95) WITHIN GROUP (ORDER BY soil_moisture))::numeric, 2) AS "P95", round((100.0 * count(*) FILTER (WHERE soil_moisture BETWEEN 20 AND 80) / NULLIF(count(soil_moisture), 0))::numeric, 1) AS "% en óptimo" FROM lectura_limpia WHERE entity_id = '$planta' AND $__timeFilter(ts)

SELECT 100.0 * count(*) FILTER (WHERE temperature BETWEEN 10 AND 35) / NULLIF(count(temperature), 0) AS "Temperatura", 100.0 * count(*) FILTER (WHERE humidity BETWEEN 30 AND 90) / NULLIF(count(humidity), 0) AS "Humedad del aire", 100.0 * count(*) FILTER (WHERE luminosity BETWEEN 1000 AND 80000) / NULLIF(count(luminosity), 0) AS "Luminosidad", 100.0 * count(*) FILTER (WHERE soil_moisture BETWEEN 20 AND 80) / NULLIF(count(soil_moisture), 0) AS "Humedad del suelo" FROM lectura_limpia WHERE entity_id = '$planta' AND $__timeFilter(ts)

SELECT 'Temperatura' AS variable, 100.0 * count(*) FILTER (WHERE temperature < 10) / NULLIF(count(temperature), 0) AS "Bajo", 100.0 * count(*) FILTER (WHERE temperature BETWEEN 10 AND 35) / NULLIF(count(temperature), 0) AS "Óptimo", 100.0 * count(*) FILTER (WHERE temperature > 35) / NULLIF(count(temperature), 0) AS "Alto" FROM lectura_limpia WHERE entity_id = '$planta' AND $__timeFilter(ts)
UNION ALL
SELECT 'Humedad del aire' AS variable, 100.0 * count(*) FILTER (WHERE humidity < 30) / NULLIF(count(humidity), 0) AS "Bajo", 100.0 * count(*) FILTER (WHERE humidity BETWEEN 30 AND 90) / NULLIF(count(humidity), 0) AS "Óptimo", 100.0 * count(*) FILTER (WHERE humidity > 90) / NULLIF(count(humidity), 0) AS "Alto" FROM lectura_limpia WHERE entity_id = '$planta' AND $__timeFilter(ts)
UNION ALL
SELECT 'Luminosidad' AS variable, 100.0 * count(*) FILTER (WHERE luminosity < 1000) / NULLIF(count(luminosity), 0) AS "Bajo", 100.0 * count(*) FILTER (WHERE luminosity BETWEEN 1000 AND 80000) / NULLIF(count(luminosity), 0) AS "Óptimo", 100.0 * count(*) FILTER (WHERE luminosity > 80000) / NULLIF(count(luminosity), 0) AS "Alto" FROM lectura_limpia WHERE entity_id = '$planta' AND $__timeFilter(ts)
UNION ALL
SELECT 'Humedad del suelo' AS variable, 100.0 * count(*) FILTER (WHERE soil_moisture < 20) / NULLIF(count(soil_moisture), 0) AS "Bajo", 100.0 * count(*) FILTER (WHERE soil_moisture BETWEEN 20 AND 80) / NULLIF(count(soil_moisture), 0) AS "Óptimo", 100.0 * count(*) FILTER (WHERE soil_moisture > 80) / NULLIF(count(soil_moisture), 0) AS "Alto" FROM lectura_limpia WHERE entity_id = '$planta' AND $__timeFilter(ts)

panels.title: Dispersión temperatura (x) vs humedad del aire (y)

targets.rawSql: SELECT temperature AS "temperatura", humidity AS "humedad" FROM lectura_limpia WHERE entity_id = '$planta' AND $__timeFilter(ts) AND temperature IS NOT NULL AND humidity IS NOT NULL ORDER BY ts DESC LIMIT 5000

panels.title: Correlación entre variables
panels.description: Pearson: +1 suben juntas, -1 una sube cuando la otra baja, 0 sin relación lineal.

targets.rawSql:
SELECT 'Temperatura vs Humedad aire' AS "Par de variables", round(corr(temperature, humidity)::numeric, 3) AS "Correlación (Pearson)", count(*) FILTER (WHERE temperature IS NOT NULL AND humidity IS NOT NULL) AS "N pares" FROM lectura_limpia WHERE entity_id = '$planta' AND $__timeFilter(ts)
UNION ALL
SELECT 'Luz vs Temperatura' AS "Par de variables", round(corr(luminosity, temperature)::numeric, 3) AS "Correlación (Pearson)", count(*) FILTER (WHERE luminosity IS NOT NULL AND temperature IS NOT NULL) AS "N pares" FROM lectura_limpia WHERE entity_id = '$planta' AND $__timeFilter(ts)
UNION ALL
SELECT 'Humedad aire vs Humedad suelo' AS "Par de variables", round(corr(humidity, soil_moisture)::numeric, 3) AS "Correlación (Pearson)", count(*) FILTER (WHERE humidity IS NOT NULL AND soil_moisture IS NOT NULL) AS "N pares" FROM lectura_limpia WHERE entity_id = '$planta' AND $__timeFilter(ts)
UNION ALL
SELECT 'Temperatura vs Humedad suelo' AS "Par de variables", round(corr(temperature, soil_moisture)::numeric, 3) AS "Correlación (Pearson)", count(*) FILTER (WHERE temperature IS NOT NULL AND soil_moisture IS NOT NULL) AS "N pares" FROM lectura_limpia WHERE entity_id = '$planta' AND $__timeFilter(ts)

SELECT to_char(dia, 'YYYY-MM-DD') AS dia, temp_min AS "mínima", temp_avg AS "media", temp_max AS "máxima" FROM resumen_diario WHERE entity_id = '$planta' AND dia BETWEEN $__timeFrom()::date AND $__timeTo()::date ORDER BY dia

panels.title: Humedad diaria promedio: aire y suelo

targets.rawSql: SELECT to_char(dia, 'YYYY-MM-DD') AS dia, hum_avg AS "aire", soil_avg AS "suelo", soil_min AS "suelo mínima" FROM resumen_diario WHERE entity_id = '$planta' AND dia BETWEEN $__timeFrom()::date AND $__timeTo()::date ORDER BY dia

SELECT to_char(dia, 'YYYY-MM-DD') AS dia, lux_avg AS "media", lux_max AS "máxima" FROM resumen_diario WHERE entity_id = '$planta' AND dia BETWEEN $__timeFrom()::date AND $__timeTo()::date ORDER BY dia

panels.title: Horas de luz suficiente por día (≥ 1000 lx)

targets.rawSql: SELECT to_char(hora AT TIME ZONE 'America/Bogota', 'YYYY-MM-DD') AS dia, count(*) FILTER (WHERE lux_avg >= 1000) AS "horas con luz", count(*) FILTER (WHERE lux_avg < 1000) AS "horas con poca luz" FROM resumen_horario WHERE entity_id = '$planta' AND $__timeFilter(hora) GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 1

panels.title: Perfil por hora del día (promedio del periodo, hora Colombia)
Temperatura y humedad por hora del día

targets.rawSql: SELECT to_char(ts AT TIME ZONE 'America/Bogota', 'HH24') || 'h' AS hora, avg(temperature) AS "temperatura (°C)", avg(humidity) AS "humedad aire (%)", avg(soil_moisture) AS "humedad suelo (%)" FROM lectura_limpia WHERE entity_id = '$planta' AND $__timeFilter(ts) GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 1

panels.title: Luz promedio por hora del día

targets.rawSql: SELECT to_char(ts AT TIME ZONE 'America/Bogota', 'HH24') || 'h' AS hora, avg(luminosity) AS "luz (lx)" FROM lectura_limpia WHERE entity_id = '$planta' AND $__timeFilter(ts) GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 1
SELECT temperature FROM lectura_limpia WHERE entity_id = '$planta' AND $__timeFilter(ts) AND temperature IS NOT NULL
SELECT humidity FROM lectura_limpia WHERE entity_id = '$planta' AND $__timeFilter(ts) AND humidity IS NOT NULL
SELECT luminosity FROM lectura_limpia WHERE entity_id = '$planta' AND $__timeFilter(ts) AND luminosity IS NOT NULL
SELECT soil_moisture FROM lectura_limpia WHERE entity_id = '$planta' AND $__timeFilter(ts) AND soil_moisture IS NOT NULL
SELECT tipo, count(*) AS alertas FROM alerta WHERE entity_id = '$planta' AND $__timeFilter(ts) GROUP BY tipo ORDER BY 2 DESC

SELECT to_char(ts AT TIME ZONE 'America/Bogota', 'YYYY-MM-DD') AS dia, count(*) FILTER (WHERE severidad = 'warning') AS "advertencias", count(*) FILTER (WHERE severidad = 'error') AS "errores" FROM alerta WHERE entity_id = '$planta' AND $__timeFilter(ts) GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 1

panels.title: Lecturas recibidas por hora
panels.description: Con envío cada 30 s se esperan ~120 por hora. Huecos = placa sin conexión.

targets.rawSql: SELECT $__timeGroupAlias(ts, '1h'), count(*) AS lecturas FROM lectura_limpia WHERE entity_id = '$planta' AND $__timeFilter(ts) GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 1

panels.title: % de lecturas válidas por sensor
panels.description: Valores que pasaron la limpieza del ETL (el resto se guardó como NULL: -999, fuera de rango o atípico).

targets.rawSql: SELECT 100.0 * count(temperature) / NULLIF(count(*), 0) AS "Temperatura", 100.0 * count(humidity) / NULLIF(count(*), 0) AS "Humedad del aire", 100.0 * count(luminosity) / NULLIF(count(*), 0) AS "Luminosidad", 100.0 * count(soil_moisture) / NULLIF(count(*), 0) AS "Humedad del suelo" FROM lectura_limpia WHERE entity_id = '$planta' AND $__timeFilter(ts)
